MAR.note: Only a cooperation declaration on AI in investigations; no rule, authority or enforcement on AI harms.
AI use by prosecutors is an intention in a declaration, not a system tendered, piloted or in service.
No locally built AI model, dataset or computing stated.

facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa, citing DGSN data relayed by the Observatoire national de la criminalite, reports 8,333 cybercrime cases in 2024 against 5,969 in 2023, without naming a law.
